scoring_justification: Cannot recompute band gaps from raw DOS without re-running DFT; compare agent's reported energies to paper's reported reference with tolerance, plus structural ordering check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference energies for DFT reproduction: pristine band gap, oxygen vacancy gap to CB transition, Ni-doped effective band gap.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Chang et al., Chem. Phys. Lett. 398 (2004) 449-452. Values from text and Table 1.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text (pristine gap 3.46 eV; vacancy GS→CB 2.6 eV; Ni-doped gap 2.3 eV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values match the paper's reported numbers and are used as hidden reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: Energy values from DFT calculations: pristine band gap, oxygen vacancy gap-to-CB transition energy, Ni-doped effective band gap. The checker also verifies the ordering pristine_band_gap_eV > ovacancy_GS_to_CB_eV and pristine_band_gap_eV > Nidoped_band_gap_eV.

output_contract.notes: The three energy values must be extracted from the DFT-computed DOS. The checker uses hidden paper-reported reference values with tolerances and verifies the required ordering.

steps.description: Compare three DFT energies and verify ordering.
